findings.detail: Minor non-blocking inconsistency between the two content gates: scripts/validate-catalog.mjs uses `value.trim().length > 0` for non-empty-string checks, while src/domain/content/catalog.ts isNonEmptyString uses `value.length > 0` (no trim). A whitespace-only string would be rejected by the build-time validator but accepted by the runtime parser. It does not affect the authored content (which passes both) or any honesty/correctness requirement; flagged only so the two gates can be kept byte-identical if desired.

summary: Phase 2 meets every stated requirement and all five verification gates are green when reproduced from source (validate-catalog, tsc --noEmit strict, eslint 0 errors, jest 8 suites / 56 tests). The domain layer is pure (no react/react-native/AsyncStorage imports; only intra-domain imports; AsyncStorage lives solely in src/persistence/store.ts). gradeMastery enforces the exactly-4 boundary (3 fail, 4 pass, 5 pass) and is unit-tested at all three points. Progression is monotonic: completeLesson de-dupes and never removes, recordMasteryResult ORs masteryPassed and maxes bestCorrectCount, and a failing retry after a pass keeps the level complete (tested). isLevelComplete derives from both lessons complete AND mastery passed against the real lesson ids. clearData removes the single goalie.v1 key and deleteAllData clears persistence first, resets memory only on success, and re-throws on failure (tested: clear -> load returns defaults). Enriched content passes the tightened validator (9 levels, 18 lessons, 45 questions) and the mirrored parser. UI states are honest: no fabricated progress/badges (badges render only when isLevelComplete; best scores show '-' when none), focus never fakes a blocked/active state (gated on the real getFocusAvailability verdict), the certificate is a clearly labeled preview showing only truly-earned levels, and the finance disclaimer is a content field surfaced by an always-visible banner and required by both validator and parser. The only new dependency is @react-native-async-storage/async-storage pinned at exactly 2.2.0 (no caret). One LOW, non-blocking trim() inconsistency between the validator and parser is noted but does not affect correctness, honesty, or the authored content.
